count_unit: Distinct, real source images after duplicate review; no copied or augmented variants count. Source recordings stay in a single split.
status: Training coverage aligned to user: >=1000 real training images/class overall; >=60% primary surface images overall; >=100 primary training positives/class and >=50 primary positives/class per independent holdout are curator quality targets. Not released.
policy_revision_reason: Remove the assistant-imposed requirement of 1000 primary-only training images per class. Retain measured surface-camera coverage and evaluation; no automatic label approval or evidence waivers.
surface_viewpoint_definition: A visually confirmed surface-camera view where boat versus shore cannot be established from one photo. Requires explicit viewpoint_basis; excludes aerial, pool, underwater and unknown views.
